shortDescription: Cobalt’s sharp rally is reversing as Democratic Republic of Congo exports of the battery metal increase under a strict new regime, according to Bloomberg.The pickup is testing the world’s top cobalt producer’s efforts to control prices.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Congo’s Cobalt Price Controls Face Pressure as Rally Fades
